# Kshana

> Open-source GNSS jamming and spoofing simulator for PNT (positioning, navigation and timing) resilience: holdover, RAIM, lunar navigation, in your browser. Version 0.29.3, AGPL-3.0-only licence, by Ashforde OÜ. 123 of 242 capabilities are validated against external oracles; the rest are labelled Modelled or partner-owned.

Kshana is a deterministic Rust engine for PNT (positioning, navigation and timing) resilience studies: GNSS (global navigation satellite system) jamming and spoofing, clock holdover, RAIM (receiver autonomous integrity monitoring) and protection levels, orbits, low-Earth-orbit navigation, and navigation at the Moon and Mars. Every scenario is a TOML file; every run is reproducible from its scenario, seed and engine version. It is not an RF (radio-frequency) signal simulator, not a GNSS receiver and not a flight product.

## Site

- [Kshana: open-source GNSS jamming and spoofing simulator](https://kshana.dev/): Open-source GNSS jamming and spoofing simulator for PNT (positioning, navigation and timing) resilience: holdover, RAIM, lunar navigation, in your browser.
- [Missions: GNSS and PNT resilience by sector](https://kshana.dev/missions): GNSS jamming, spoofing and clock holdover scenarios for ten sectors, from defence, aviation and maritime to telecom timing and lunar navigation.
- [Capabilities: GNSS, clocks, orbits, Moon and Mars](https://kshana.dev/capabilities): GNSS signal bands and jamming, clock holdover, timing masks, integrity monitoring (RAIM), orbits and lunar navigation: every scenario kind on one map.
- [Evidence: validation against external oracles](https://kshana.dev/evidence): Which Kshana capabilities are validated against independent oracles and which are modelled: verification matrix, validation ledger, papers and citation.
- [Install Kshana: CLI, Rust, Python, npm and MCP server](https://kshana.dev/developers): Install Kshana as a command-line tool, Rust crate, Python or npm package, Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, container or JetBrains plugin.
- [Editions: open source and Kshana Pro](https://kshana.dev/editions): Kshana is free and open source under the AGPL-3.0 licence. Kshana Pro adds a design optimiser, uncertainty and sensitivity studies and a mission dossier.
- [Kshana Studio](https://kshana.dev/studio/): Run GNSS jamming, spoofing, holdover and integrity scenarios in your browser. The open-source engine runs locally as WebAssembly; nothing is uploaded.

## Install

- Command line (Rust): `cargo install kshana` (https://crates.io/crates/kshana)
- Rust library: `cargo add kshana` (https://crates.io/crates/kshana)
- Python: `pip install kshana` (https://pypi.org/project/kshana/)
- JavaScript and WebAssembly: `npm install kshana` (https://www.npmjs.com/package/kshana)
- AI assistant (MCP server): `cargo install kshana-mcp` (https://crates.io/crates/kshana-mcp)
- Docker image: `docker run --rm -i ghcr.io/ashfordeou/kshana-mcp` (https://github.com/ashfordeOU/kshana/pkgs/container/kshana-mcp)
- Source code: https://github.com/ashfordeOU/kshana
- Cite the software: DOI [10.5281/zenodo.20528627](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20528627)

## Research

- [The Cost of Lunar South-Polar Geometry, and Surface Beacons as the Efficient Fix: A Dilution-of-Precision Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.06212): arXiv 2607.06212. Planned orbits bunch overhead for a lunar south-pole user; a few ranging beacons on nearby high ground fix the geometry more cheaply than more satellites.
- [Earth-baseline VLBI restores the observability of a lunar surface station in joint orbit-and-clock determination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02566): arXiv 2607.02566. Lunar-network ranging fixes only relative geometry; an Earth-baseline very-long-baseline interferometry delay ties a surface station to the Earth frame, even with few satellites.
- [A Conditional Timing Protection Level: Holdover-Limited Undetected Time Error Under GNSS Spoofing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.24210): arXiv 2606.24210. A recorded spoof shows a timing receiver serving time far more wrong than it reports; no unconditional bound exists, so the paper bounds the undetected error conditionally.
- [How Stable Is a PNT Resilience Score? Decision-Instability of Single-Number Resilience Ratings under Framework-Aligned Weighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05415): arXiv 2607.05415. Single-number resilience ratings for positioning, navigation and timing are stable only where one design dominates; weighting, threat and declared techniques can flip them.
- [Anticipating the Optimism Gap: Predicting Distribution-Shift Degradation of RF-Impairment Detectors from In-Distribution Statistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22054): arXiv 2606.22054. How much an interference detector loses under shifted conditions can be predicted from its own in-distribution scores; synthetic results, checked on open field recordings.

## Docs: Scenarios

- [Scenario kinds](https://kshana.dev/docs/scenarios): The 75 built-in scenario kinds that kshana::api::run_toml dispatches over, each with its one-line description and its required / optional TOML (Tom's…
- [Scenario reference](https://kshana.dev/docs/scenario-reference): Every bundled scenario file (138), grouped by kind. The description is the file's own header comment; the key parameters are its top-level settings.
- [Result schema — reading a Kshana *.result.json](https://kshana.dev/docs/schema): Every run writes a versioned, self-describing JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) artifact next to the scenario.
- [Using real constellation TLEs](https://kshana.dev/docs/real-tle-guide): The bundled scenarios/orbit-sgp4-gps.toml already carries real TLEs (two-line element sets): the Celestrak gps-ops snapshot of the operational GPS…
- [Campaigns](https://kshana.dev/docs/campaigns): A single scenario answers one question about one situation. A mission is a sequence of situations, and a design study is a family of them.

## Docs: Quantum sensors

- [Quantum-sensor models](https://kshana.dev/docs/quantum-models): Kshana is a PNT-resilience (PNT: positioning, navigation and timing) simulator with quantum-sensor performance models.
- [Quantum inertial-sensor physics](https://kshana.dev/docs/quantum-physics): Most of Kshana drives its quantum sensors from published Allan/noise coefficients — datasheet lookups (see QUANTUM-MODELS.md and PROVENANCE.md).

## Docs: APIs and integrations

- [Python API](https://kshana.dev/docs/python-api): Kshana ships a first-class Python application programming interface (API), built with PyO3 and maturin.
- [npm and WebAssembly](https://kshana.dev/docs/npm): Kshana replays jamming, spoofing and clock holdover when GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System) signals fail, and tells you how long a system keeps…
- [Rust crate](https://kshana.dev/docs/rust): Try it first with nothing to install: Kshana Studio runs the whole engine in your browser, compiled to WebAssembly, and uploads nothing.
- [kshana-mcp](https://kshana.dev/docs/mcp): kshana-mcp is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Kshana, the open-source simulator for PNT (positioning, navigation and timing) resilience.
- [Kshana for JetBrains IDEs](https://kshana.dev/docs/jetbrains): Install: Kshana — PNT simulator on the JetBrains Marketplace — or, in any JetBrains IDE, Settings → Plugins → Marketplace → search "Kshana".
- [Where Kshana runs, and where it does not](https://kshana.dev/docs/deployment-targets): A scope boundary, written down so that nobody discovers it as a commitment in a meeting.
- [Architecture](https://kshana.dev/docs/architecture): Kshana is one engine organised in layers over a shared core: the sensor packs (clock, inertial, time-transfer, hybrid); an astrodynamics / numerical…
- [Where Kshana sits](https://kshana.dev/docs/positioning): Kshana is an open, reproducible PNT (positioning, navigation and timing) resilience evidence engine.

- [Changelog](https://kshana.dev/docs/changelog): The format is based on Keep a Changelog, and this project adheres to Semantic Versioning.

- [Security policy](https://kshana.dev/docs/security): Please do not open a public issue for security-sensitive reports. We aim to acknowledge within a few business days.
- [Contributing to Kshana](https://kshana.dev/docs/contributing): Thanks for your interest. Kshana aims to be a neutral, reproducible, honestly- validated reference for hybrid quantum/classical PNT.
- [Kshana governance](https://kshana.dev/docs/governance): This document states how Kshana is governed: who makes decisions, how, and what the project will and will not absorb.
